title: Grid-based cell picking
details: Использовать spatial grid для поиска ближайших клеток при клике мышью вместо перебора всех. main.py. Сложность O(1) вместо O(N).
notes: Optimized _pick_cell in main.py from O(N) linear scan to O(k) spatial grid lookup. Changes: (1) _pick_cell(cells, wx, wy, zoom) now accepts grid=None; when grid provided, narrows candidates to +/-3 grid cells around click position using spatial grid, sorts indices to preserve selection order; falls back to linear scan when grid=None (backward compatible). (2) Added grid_wrapper.refresh() before first _pick_cell call site (line ~781) to ensure grid is current, especially for Cython path where refresh is only in Python fallback. (3) Both call sites now pass grid_wrapper.grid. Tested: backward compat verified, grid path matches linear scan for all 50 test cells, 8s sim smoke test passed.
